paper.title: Assessing data-driven predictions of band gap and electrical conductivity for transparent conducting materials
paper.research_summary: This paper proposes a data-driven framework to accelerate the discovery of new transparent conducting materials (TCMs) by predicting band gap and electrical conductivity from stoichiometry alone, using experimentally validated datasets and state-of-the-art ML models evaluated via bespoke methods including leave-one-TCM-family-out to assess ability to identify previously unseen TCM families.

task.task_name_raw: accelerating the discovery of new transparent conducting materials (TCMs)
task.objective: accelerating the discovery of new transparent conducting materials (TCMs)
constraints: low absorption in the range of visible light
band gap exceeding the energy of visible light (approximately 3 eV)
output_goal: identify new TCMs compositionally similar to those in training data
highlight material candidates that may have been previously overlooked

evidence.text: Here, we propose a data-driven framework aimed at accelerating the discovery of new transparent conducting materials (TCMs), an important category of semiconductors with a wide range of applications.

stages.stage_name_raw: creating and validating unique experimental databases
stages.stage_goal: create and validate experimental databases comprising several examples of existing TCMs to mitigate shortage of available data

evidence.text: To mitigate the shortage of available data, we create and validate unique experimental databases, comprising several examples of existing TCMs.

To address the limitation of optical property data, we adopt the band gap (Eg) as a proxy for optical transparency... To enable a ML approach, we have created and validated two experimental datasets of room-temperature conductivity and band gap measurements, to be used as foundation for training SOTA ML models for the discovery of new TCMs.

stages.stage_name_raw: preprocessing raw conductivity and band gap data
stages.stage_goal: process raw data to remove unphysical entries and ensure wide chemical diversity

evidence.text: Several preprocessing steps were conducted on the raw data. Initially, we excluded all pure elements and noble gases and selected all chemical formulas reported within a window of room temperature (298 ± 5 K), reducing the dataset to 14 307 entries.
Preprocessing steps were applied to the raw data. Specifically, we excluded groups of duplicated formulas with band gap measurements having a standard deviation greater than 0.1 eV.

stages.stage_name_raw: domain expert validation of conductivity and band gap measurements
stages.stage_goal: ensure accuracy of reported conductivity measurements and correctness of corresponding chemical formulas through line-by-line expert review

evidence.text: At this stage, we performed a meticulous validation, which involved a line-by-line review of the obtained data by domain experts, referring back to the original literature on suspicious entries, to ensure the accuracy of the reported conductivity measurements, alongside the correctness of the corresponding chemical formulas.
The validated datasets were used as foundation for evaluating SOTA ML models for property-prediction from the stoichiometry alone.

stages.stage_name_raw: training state-of-the-art ML models for property prediction
stages.stage_goal: train Random Forest and CrabNet models to predict band gap and electrical conductivity from stoichiometry

evidence.text: We assess state-of-the-art (SOTA) ML models for property prediction from the stoichiometry alone.
We utilize the obtained data to train state-of-the-art (SOTA) ML models that leverage the stoichiometry of input materials...

stages.stage_name_raw: assessing model performance with bespoke evaluation schemes
stages.stage_goal: evaluate trained models using K-fold, LOCO-CV, and leave-one-TCM-family-out to determine ability to identify previously unseen TCMs

evidence.text: We propose a bespoke evaluation scheme to provide empirical evidence on the ability of ML to uncover new, previously unseen materials of interest.
We empirically measure the ability of ML models to identify new classes of TCMs through a bespoke evaluation method.

stages.stage_goal: test the framework on a list of 55 experimentally-reported chemical compositions to identify materials likely to display TCM characteristics
stage_output: materials meeting TCM criteria (Eg > 3 eV and s > 102 S cm−1)

evidence.text: We test our approach on a list of 55 compositions containing typical elements of known TCMs.
